solutions.title: Resettable Aftershock Bruiser
solutions.summary: Now and Again is the relevant Chronomancer bridge: occasional cooldown recovery gives a second use of a high-impact mace button, rather than pretending the ascendancy directly scales attack damage. Build around a high-physical two-handed mace and Earthquake: plant the initial hit, reposition during the delay, then let the aftershock carry clear and boss damage. Armour Breaker can prepare durable targets and Sunder is a credible faster-payoff alternative when waiting for aftershocks is unsafe. Keep conversion low so physical scaling, armour interaction, and the weapon’s large local damage all point in one direction. Attack speed should be sufficient to make the character responsive, but the build values damage per hit, area, and cooldown utility more than frantic attacking. This is one of the cleanest slices because the mace is both the legal carrier and the best source of base physical damage; Chronomancer contributes tempo and safety instead of an artificial damage gimmick.
solutions.playstyle: Break armour when needed, place Earthquake, move through the delayed detonation, and use a reset high-impact attack on priority targets.
solutions.defense: Use armour from strength gear, cap resistances, and let Apex of the Moment slow nearby enemies while you commit to long mace animations.
priorities: high local physical mace damage
area and attack speed sufficient for safe slams
strength, accuracy, physical penetration or armour interaction

solutions.title: Starborn Cold Control
solutions.summary: Now and Again is the relevant Chronomancer bridge: occasional cooldown recovery gives a second use of a high-impact mace button, rather than pretending the ascendancy directly scales attack damage. Starborn Onslaught is the catalog’s unusually useful mace-native cold route: it converts physical toward cold, carries cold and physical properties, inflicts chill, and modifies freeze. That is stronger evidence than forcing an unrestricted spell beside an otherwise decorative mace. Scale the weapon’s physical base, conversion, cold attack damage, and ailment magnitude; use the repeated hits and chill to make slow mace commitments safer. Herald of Ice can reward frozen-pack kills, but its own hit is recorded as unable to freeze, so freeze application must come from the attack rather than the herald. Chronomancer reinforces the control identity through nearby slowing and can recycle a separate cooldown attack for burst.
solutions.playstyle: Drive Starborn Onslaught through packs, use chilled or frozen windows to remain in melee, and reserve the reset for a burst mace attack.
solutions.defense: Use armour from strength gear, cap resistances, and let Apex of the Moment slow nearby enemies while you commit to long mace animations.

solutions.title: Endurance-Fuelled Ancestral Totem
